forecast-period.text: A trough of low pressure over the far northeast will linger over the far northeast until mid week. A high pressure to the east extends a ridge across southern SA. A trough of low pressure approaches the western border on Wednesday then moves across the west and north of the State on Thursday and eastern parts on Friday. Another ridge pushes into the west later Friday and over the weekend.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Possible showers and thunderstorms developing about the northwest and west, possibly severe in the far northwest and southwest. Maximum temperatures generally above average, grading to below average in the west. East to northeasterly winds, tending moderate to fresh and gusty northeast to northwesterly in the west ahead of a south to southeasterly change in the southwest later.
Possible showers and thunderstorms about the far northeast and far northwest. Southwest to southeasterly winds, tending east to northeasterly in the west.

Showers and thunderstorms about the Flinders and Pastoral districts and in the west, possibly severe in the far northwest. Maximum temperatures above average, grading to below average in the west and north. Generally southeast to northeasterly winds, fresh and gusty at times in the north.

Possible showers and thunderstorms about central and eastern districts. Maximum temperatures generally above average, grading to below average in the west and north. East to northeasterly winds in the east, with southwest to southeasterly winds extending throughout during the day.

text.p: Showers about the agricultural area. Maximum temperatures near average to slightly above average about central and eastern parts, grading to below average in the west. Southwest to southeasterly winds, fresh at times near coastal parts.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Saturday: Less than 5 mm, increasing to 5 to 15 mm about western, northern and eastern parts and increasing further to 15 to 30 mm about parts of the west, east and the Flinders and Pastoral districts. Local falls of 30 to 50 mm possible with thunderstorms, mainly about the Finders and Pastoral districts.
